name: Church Website Audit by Journey Digital
description: Local stdio server from tnvolman/jd-church-website-audit. Configure the script itself as the command (./server/audit-mcp.js or its absolute path, with a #!/usr/bin/env node shebang). Guard matches only the command basename audit-mcp.js; a node command with the script in args is not matched. audit_church_website only POSTs {url, source:"plugin", include_cta?} to https://journeydigital.ai/api/audit. It does not fetch or upload page HTML, read local files, or need credentials. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: Configure the server with the script itself as the command (e.g. ./server/audit-mcp.js with a node shebang). Guard matches only the command basename audit-mcp.js; a node interpreter command with the script in args is not matched.
audit_church_website only POSTs {url, source:"plugin", include_cta?}. It does not fetch or upload page HTML, read local files, or need credentials.
Use the browser checker at https://journeydigital.ai/audit if you do not want the local server/audit-mcp.js process.
